$description: How a designer's Figma styles are auto-mapped onto the base design system's CORE tier. A brand only overrides core primitives; semantic, base, and components are inherited from the base unchanged. The MCP doorway serves this file so any AI tool maps a brand the same way.
principles: A brand is a new set of CORE values against the same base. Never rewrite semantic/base/components.
Prefer a value read from Figma over a value invented by the tool. Flag anything derived.
If Figma gives one seed colour for a ramp, derive the ramp but mark every derived tone 'review'.
Never ship a brand whose action colour fails WCAG AA against its text — warn and require sign-off.

color.brand.note: The brand's signature colour. Full ramp preferred; single seed is derived.

color.neutral.note: Greys for text, borders, surfaces. Falls back to base neutrals if absent.

font.size.note: Size ramp by name (xs..10xl). Missing steps inherit base.

radius.note: Named radii (none..full). A single value is applied to 'md' and scaled.

spacing.note: Named spacing steps. Missing steps inherit base.

elevation.note: Rarely brand-specific; inherit base unless Figma defines shadows.

confidence.high: Read directly from a named Figma variable/style at the expected role.
confidence.derived: Computed by the tool (e.g. a ramp built from one seed). Designer must confirm.
confidence.inherited: Not present in the Figma file; kept from the base system default.
